test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per information received till July 2022, which of the following states has set up 'Bharosa Kendras', which provide one-stop services for women and children, who are victims of sexual assault and violence?
solution:
The correct answer is__ "**Telangana**".__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Department of Women and Child Development**, **Telangana** provided logistical support, finance, and assistance for the **establishment of BHAROSA** as a Society **for Protection of Women** and Children in Hyderabad in May 2016.
 
• BHAROSA** offers rapid access to** expert services to everyone who knocks on its doors.
 
• In addition to **psychological counselling**, a variety of police, **medical, legal, **and prosecution services are offered in an integrated manner.
 
• **Relief and rehabilitation **are the results of this multifaceted help, if necessary.
 
• Thus, as per information received till **July 2022, Telangana** has **set up 'Bharosa Kendras',** which provide one-stop services for women and children, who are **victims of sexual assault and violence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Over the years, there has been an **increase in sexual offences** in the nation.
 
• Although the government adopted the **Prevention of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (POCSO)** in response to the need for a specific law to **address crimes against children**, its execution required significant support on the ground.
 
• **Up to 3,000 POCSO incidents** are reported and looked into **annually**, and four child sexual assault victims are **denied justice every day** because police close their investigations due to a lack of information or** insufficient proof.**
